title: languas sericea
intro: Languas sericea, commonly known as Silver Vine, is a plant species in the Asparagaceae family, native to Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing anxiety, insomnia, and stress due to its sedative properties. The therapeutic actions of Languas sericea include inducing relaxation and promoting a calm state, making it a popular ingredient in herbal teas and supplements. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects are primarily attributed to the presence of flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which have been shown to possess anxiolytic, sedative, and calming properties.
